records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The uterine visceral afferent fibres usually follow sympathetic efferents to which of the following spinal cord segments:
records.explanation: The uterus receives its sympathetic supply primarily from the inferior hypogastric plexus and its parasympathetic supply from the pelvic splanchnic nerves (S2 - $4), with visceral afferent fibres usually following the sympathetic fibres to enter the spinal cord via T10 - T12 and L1 nerve fibres. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The posterior wall of the inguinal canal is formed primarily by which of the following structures:
records.explanation: The posterior wall of the inguinal canal is formed along its entire length by the transversalis fascia and reinforced by the conjoint tendon medially. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww The arterial supply to the pancreas is mainly derived from which of the following: oO
records.explanation: The arterial supply to the pancreas is primarily derived from the splenic artery from the coeliac trunk, assisted by branches from the gastroduodenal artery (from the common hepatic artery from the coeliac trunk), and from the superior mesenteric artery. ; , Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: w The kidneys are related posteriorly to all of the following structures EXCEPT for the:
records.explanation: Posteriorly both kidneys are related superiorly to the diaphragm and ribs and inferiorly (moving from medial to lateral) the psoas major, quadratus lumborum and transversus abdominis muscles. The pleural sacs and the costodiaphragmatic recesses also extend posterior to the kidneys. ‘ : . Vv

records.stem: Which of the following lies immediately medial to the second part of the duodenum:
